measured_facts: FpsGazeTracker.MaxTrackedColliders is 64 and the overflow path is a silent return (FpsGazeTracker.cs:31). The dwell dictionary only grows when the player ACTUALLY gazes at a collider — Bind() is a one-line assignment and registers nothing. So 12 units times 4 points = 48 is potential, not immediate.

FacilityInspectable.Corroded and TutorialSession.PendingVerdict are a matched pair. TutorialSession.ApplyEffect increments MisjudgementCount when they disagree, so setting Corroded=true on all 12 while only one has an answer key would manufacture false misjudgements.
The four point ids body/spec-plate/serial/gauge are matched by literal against TutorialSession.cs:92-95 and must stay byte-identical.
TutorialSession.Audit() uses Target.name as the finding prefix (TutorialSession.cs:157) and Bind() uses it as the report subject (:75), so a shared RootName across 12 units breaks the report.
FpsAuditTerminalTests.cs:137-138 asserts the subject appears an exact number of times in the terminal body.
FirstPersonResponder.RefreshInteraction keeps only the nearest non-self collider within InteractionDistance clamped to 3m, so units closer than a few metres to each other create ambiguity.
The 12 v3 positions are spread across five walled rooms of 785, 404, 225, 106 and 45 sqm; the closest pair is about 2m apart (48,-47) and (48,-49).

inspectable_scope.instructions: Which of the 12 units should carry FacilityInspectable with the 4 observation colliders?

criteria.all_twelve_with_per_unit_state: All 12 get FacilityInspectable with their own serial and their own world state, so the building is consistent and any unit can be inspected later; only one carries the tutorial answer key
criteria.one_tutorial_target_rest_props: Only the designated tutorial unit is inspectable; the other 11 are model-only props that satisfy the regulation visually
criteria.all_twelve_same_state: All 12 inspectable and all with Corroded=true like today

session_and_terminal.instructions: How many TutorialSession and AuditTerminal instances should exist?

criteria.one_each_hoisted: Exactly one TutorialSession bound to the designated tutorial unit and exactly one AuditTerminal, both created outside the per-unit loop and parented outside any single unit root
criteria.one_per_unit: One session and one terminal per unit as today

destroy_sweep.instructions: The builder currently clears the previous build with GameObject.Find(RootName) then destroys it. With 12 distinct names, what should it do?

criteria.iterate_roots_by_prefix: Iterate the scene roots and destroy every root whose name starts with RootName, before the loop begins
criteria.keep_find: Keep GameObject.Find, which returns only one active object

proximity_guard.instructions: Two v3 positions are about 2m apart, within the 3m interaction clamp. What should the builder do?

criteria.assert_and_report: Measure the minimum pairwise distance, refuse or loudly report when two units are closer than the interaction distance, so the ambiguity cannot pass silently
criteria.ignore: Place them anyway and let the nearest-collider rule decide
